headline: Of every 100 pesos of the 2027 PEF, 96 are already committed
summary: According to México Evalúa, 96 of every 100 pesos in the 2027 Economic Package are already committed. Fiscal space for 2027 would be 325,400 million pesos.
why: Fiscal space measures how much discretionary spending a government has left, which matters for investors assessing Mexico's public finances and debt outlook.
original_headline: De cada 100 pesos del PEF 2027, 96 ya están comprometidos
